notifications.title: Notifications

pause.title: Pause / vacation
pause.subtitle: Pause your goals while you are away, with no failures and no consequences.
pause.ruleSkipped: During the pause, your deadlines are marked “Paused”: none can fail, no consequence or penalty is applied, and no reminder is sent.
pause.ruleStreak: Your streak is frozen: pause days neither break nor extend it. It picks up where it left off.
pause.ruleLimits: A pause starts today at the earliest (no retroactive pause) and lasts at most {max} days.
pause.alreadyPlanned: A pause is already active or planned. End or cancel it to create a new one.
pause.created: Pause planned. | Pause planned, {count} deadline paused. | Pause planned, {count} deadlines paused.
pause.endedFeedback: Pause ended: your upcoming deadlines are back to do.

errors.start_in_past: A pause cannot start in the past.
errors.end_before_start: The end date must come after the start date.
errors.too_long: A pause lasts at most {max} days.
errors.overlap: This period overlaps an existing pause.

partner.title: Partner
partner.subtitle: A trusted person sees your daily status, and you see theirs.
partner.streak: Streak: {count} days | Streak: {count} day | Streak: {count} days
partner.privacy: Your partner only sees your first name, today's status, your streak and your last 7 days. Never your goal titles, notes, proofs, credits, payments or consequences.
partner.confirmRevoke: End the partnership? You will no longer see each other's status.
partner.inviteExplain: Create an invitation link and send it to someone you trust. Once accepted, you will each see the other's status.
partner.linkHint: Valid for 7 days, single use. Generating a new link invalidates the previous one.
partner.pendingInvite: An invitation is pending. For security, the link is only shown when created: generate a new one if needed.

invite.title: {name} invites you to be their accountability partner
invite.explain: You will each see the other's daily status (completed, late, failed) to keep each other on track.
invite.privacy: Only first name, daily status, streak and last 7 days are shared. No goal details, no payment data. You can end it at any time.

errors.invalid_invite: This invitation link is invalid or has already been used.
errors.self: You cannot accept your own invitation.
errors.already_partnered: You already have a partner. End it before accepting another one.
errors.inviter_partnered: This person already has a partner.

challenges.title: Challenges
challenges.subtitle: One week, a few friends, one leaderboard. The most consistent wins.
challenges.name: Challenge name
challenges.stakeHint: The stake is taken from your balance when you join (current balance: {balance} credits) and the winner takes the pot. Credits only, never real money.
challenges.rules: Stake: {n} credits. First place takes the pot (split on a tie). Leaving before the start refunds your stake; after that it stays in the pot.
challenges.finishing: The week is over: results and winnings are awarded Monday at noon (UTC).
challenges.cancelledExplain: Fewer than 2 participants at the end of the week: the challenge is cancelled and stakes are refunded.
challenges.inviteExplain: Share this link: it stays valid until the challenge is full or you generate a new one. Participants only see first names and scores.
challenges.confirmLeave: Leave the challenge? Your stake stays in the pot.
challenges.confirmLeaveRefund: Leave the challenge? Your stake will be refunded.

accountData.title: Your data
accountData.intro: Download a copy of all your data or permanently delete your account.
accountData.exportHint: JSON file: profile, goals, deadlines, proofs, credits, consequences, challenges and notifications. No passwords, tokens or payment identifiers.
accountData.deleteHint: This cannot be undone. Your account is closed right away: goals stopped, pending consequences cancelled, challenges left, partner revoked, proofs and card removed. The rest of your data is permanently purged at the end of the instance's retention period (30 days by default).
accountData.exportFirst: Export your data first: it cannot be recovered afterwards.
accountData.adminBlocked: Administrator accounts cannot be deleted from the app.
